name: chickencorp
title: top chicken: a category retrospective
blurb: a 10-slide corporate deck researching the phrase "top chicken" — turns out it wasn't an idiom before topchicken.bisks.net invented one on 2026-07-29, so this is the origin story, the etymology of its idiom cousins, and a competitive-landscape slide. @cee.wtf asked for the research.
